'''Aila Helano''' was a corporate researcher who possessed a formula for a new [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]], a "wonder stim,"<ref name="Mission" /> by [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Secret Recipe" was released with ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'', it must also take place around that year.</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She sought to sell her formula directly to one of the two [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] powers.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two warring governments had a companion successfully broker a meeting between a representative of their government and Helano.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Aila Helano was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Secret Recipe" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] expansion of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Mission" />
